topic: Two-Level Evaluation Architecture and Occam's Razor Selection Oracle
problem_statement: Design an evaluation protocol that explores multiple ALS hyperparameter combinations under strict resource bounds while guaranteeing zero data leakage and uncompromised full validation rigour.
root_cause: Scoring 109,779 full validation users takes ~165 seconds per trial. Running full generation for 6 trials would consume excessive runtime.
solution_or_decision: Implement Level 1 Screening Cohort (deterministic sample of 5,000 positive validation users, seed 42) reducing trial scoring to 7-9 seconds. Implement independent Selection Oracle sorting trials by NDCG@10 DESC, HitRate@10 DESC, rank ASC (Occam's razor), regParam ASC, and trial_id ASC. Only the selected finalist is evaluated on Level 2 Full Validation (109,779 users). Strict test split guard raises PermissionError if any test path is accessed.
evidence: Selection Oracle selected ALS_R8_REG0.3_ITER10 (rank=8, train time 100.4s vs 396.5s for rank=32). Level 2 Full Validation evaluated 109,779 users, generating 2,195,580 recommendations in 165.25s (664.3 users/s) with 0 failures.
